

== Separate published card versions ==
The original published version has its own full card article at [[Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi]], with original title, image and text and the original-state identifier <code>1271_1o</code>. [[Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi]] retains <code>1271_1</code>. [[Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi/Publication history]] connects the articles and preserves the source evidence. This follows Bill’s clarification that a history section must not replace a published card-version article. The identifier documents the intended text state; this wiki edit does not claim a GEMP implementation or deployment.
